name: Change Authorization
objective: Ensure all requested changes are formally authorized prior to starting development.
description: Changes to production systems, applications, and infrastructure must be authorized by an appropriate owner or authority before implementation or design begins.

name: Change Development and Configuration
objective: Track development activity and connect code commits to authorized changes.
description: All modifications to source code or configurations must be tracked and associated with an authorized change request or ticket.

name: Change Testing
objective: Verify that changes are adequately tested prior to deployment to production.
description: Testing (unit, integration, regression, or manual user acceptance testing) must be executed and verified as successful prior to deploying changes to production.

name: Change Approval
objective: Ensure changes are approved by an authorized individual other than the developer.
description: Every normal change must receive formal approval from an authorized peer or authority after testing and prior to deployment.

name: Segregation of Duties
objective: Prevent the same individual from developing and approving/deploying a change.
description: The person who requests or implements a change must not be the one who approves or deploys the change to production.

name: Deployment Authorization
objective: Prevent unauthorized deployments to the production environment.
description: Production deployments must only be executed for authorized and approved changes, utilizing automated pipelines where possible.

name: Change Traceability
objective: Enable end-to-end traceability of a change from request to deployment.
description: Maintain a continuous audit trail linking authorization, code commits, testing records, approval, and final deployment.

name: Emergency Change Management
objective: Provide an expedited path for urgent changes with subsequent verification.
description: Emergency changes bypass normal approval timelines but require specific emergency justifications and are subject to immediate post-deployment review.

name: Change Documentation
objective: Ensure all details of the change are documented properly.
description: All changes must have documentation including title, description, application affected, risk level, and environment target.

name: Evidence Management
objective: Maintain permanent, verifiable records of compliance evidence.
description: Evidence demonstrating controls compliance must be captured, cataloged with metadata, and securely stored.

name: Post-Change Review
objective: Evaluate change success and resolve unauthorized issues.
description: Perform reviews of changes post-deployment, specifically for emergency or failed changes, to ensure system stability and compliance.
